name: Tribal / Kindred
summary: Creature-type-matters: lords that buff the tribe, mana engines that scale with tribe density, universal tribal-support artifacts/enchantments, and tribe-specific utility. First instance parameterized on Elf; query idioms apply to any tribe via color-identity splice at runtime.
_status_note: Live recipe — Gate 2 + Gate 3 approved 2026-05-14 by local-board via DEC-260 confirmation interaction ca491970. 18/18 = 100% canon recall validated empirically against Scryfall API.

canon_approval._note: Canon (Gate 2) and recipe (Gate 3) approved together via single request_confirmation interaction.

elf_lords.intent: Creatures that pump other Elves +1/+1 — the core lord effect that scales linearly with board presence. Two oracle phrasings exist ('Elf creatures' vs 'Elves').
queries: f:commander t:creature o:"other elf creatures you control get +1/+1"
f:commander t:creature o:"other elves you control get +1/+1"

canon_recall.noise_notes: Query A also surfaces Joraga Warcaller (counter-based lord — relevant). Query B surfaces Canopy Tactician (lord + {G}{G}{G} tap — relevant), Galadhrim Brigade (Squad lord — relevant), Morcant's Loyalist (BG, on-death recursion — multi-color noise). All noise is genuine elf tribal support.

elf_mana_engines.intent: Elves that produce mana scaled by elf count or elf density — the engine layer that makes elfball explosive.
queries: f:commander t:elf o:"untapped elves you control" o:"add"
f:commander t:elf o:"another elf you control enters" o:"+1/+1 counter"

canon_recall.noise_notes: Query A also catches Allosaurus Shepherd ('{4}{G}{G}: each Elf...' matches oracle; noise here but canon in elf_utility). Query B catches Birchlore Rangers (two-untapped variant — relevant). Query C is uniquely precise: only Marwyn.

tribal_support_artifacts.intent: Universal 'choose a creature type' artifacts that provide anthem, cost reduction, or draw for any tribe. Color-identity agnostic — strong in any tribal shell.
queries: f:commander o:"as this artifact enters, choose a creature type"

canon_recall.noise_notes: Query returns 17 total. Other top-EDHREC results include Urza's Incubator (cost -2, all-tribe staple — high signal), Patchwork Banner (anthem + mana, in verdant-tide), Icon of Ancestry (anthem + sift — relevant), Banner of Kinship (ETB-scaled anthem — relevant). Noise is almost entirely genuine tribal support.

tribal_draw_enchantments.intent: Universal 'choose a creature type' enchantments that draw cards whenever the chosen tribe enters or attacks — the strongest recurring draw engine for tribal.
queries: f:commander o:"as this enchantment enters, choose a creature type" o:"draw a card"

canon_recall.noise_notes: Broader query without 'draw a card' returns 20 results including Reflections of Littjara (copy tribal spells — high signal), Arcane Adaptation (type-grant enabler), Cover of Darkness (fear, black-only), Etchings of the Chosen (WB indestructible). Narrow query surfaces only Kindred Discovery. Board may consider adding the broader query as a second query in this sub-recipe for coverage.

elf_utility.intent: High-impact elf-specific utility pieces: bounce-untap (Wirewood Symbiote), repeatable overrun (Ezuri), and counterspell protection (Allosaurus Shepherd). Each has a unique oracle idiom.
queries: f:commander o:"return an elf you control" o:"untap"
f:commander t:elf o:"elf creatures you control get +3/+3"
f:commander t:elf o:"green spells you control can't be countered"

canon_recall.noise_notes: All three queries are uniquely precise — 1 result each. Zero noise.

tribal_anthem_global.intent: Global anthems that scale with shared creature types rather than a chosen type — rewards uniform tribal composition.
queries: f:commander o:"shares at least one creature type with it" o:"+1/+1"

tribal_commanders.intent: Canonical elf tribal commanders that incentivize stacking elves — drain payoff (Lathril) and token-mana engine (Freyalise).
queries: is:commander t:elf o:"untapped elves you control"
is:commander t:elf o:"elf druid creature token"

canon_recall.noise_notes: Query A also catches other elf commanders with 'untapped elves' drain lines (high signal). Query B is precise to Freyalise's +2 create elf Druid token text; may also surface Llanowar Tribe or similar — review top-EDHREC results.

wildcard.intent: Broad elf-matters sweep — catches new printings with non-standard phrasing. High noise, run last, review top-10 only.
queries: f:commander t:elf o:"whenever" o:"elf" o:"enters" order:edhrec

canon_recall.note: Wildcard sub-recipe not validated against canon — exists to surface printings the precise queries miss. Expected high noise.

excludes._note: No global excludes defined for tribal. Tribal decks rarely include symmetric punishers; apply exclude clauses per-deck as needed.

runtime_semantics.color_identity_splice: Append `id<=<deck color identity>` per query at runtime. Critical for tribal — many cross-tribe staples (Herald's Horn, Coat of Arms) are colorless and will survive the splice regardless of deck color. Elf-specific queries are already mono-green, so splice has minimal effect on them.
runtime_semantics.tribe_parameterization: The elf_lords, elf_mana_engines, elf_utility, and tribal_commanders sub-recipes are parameterized on Elf. When using this recipe for a non-elf tribal deck, substitute the target tribe name in those queries. The tribal_support_artifacts, tribal_draw_enchantments, and tribal_anthem_global sub-recipes are tribe-agnostic and require no substitution.
runtime_semantics.decklist_exclusion: Post-fetch — filter out any name already in decklist or candidates.json top-50.
